scope: Source-backed material inputs for the proposed cleats, not a complete connection capacity or adoption.

source.title: APA Panel Design Specification, D510F, September 2020

required_panel: APA Rated Sturd-I-Floor 48 oc PS 1 plywood, at least five plies; Group 1 for the fastener-bearing basis.

narrow_strip_factor.source: D510F section4.5.5, factor applies to panel bending strength and axial tension.
narrow_strip_factor.width_definition: Width perpendicular to the checked normal stress/span within the panel plane, not always the leaf's long dimension.
narrow_strip_factor.local_bores_and_net_width: Use the applicable reduced width and deductions; the gross factor does not qualify hole or connection stress transfer.

units_and_derivation: FtA and FcA are force per panel width; FbS is moment per width. They are not stresses until divided by the applicable section property.
Fvtv controls shear in the YZ panel plane. Fs(Ib/Q) is the rolling/flat-beam shear reference and is directional.
EA and EI describe distinct laminate extension/bending behavior. A single homogeneous E cannot in general match both.
Table9 Gvtv is in-plane panel rigidity; it does not supply an out-of-plane rolling-shear modulus or a bore/contact spring law.
The panel orientation, strip width and property direction must be joined explicitly for every cut. Do not use the500 strong-axis rolling value for a Y-normal cut with strengthaxisZ.

corrections.error: Its Y-normal cut used Fs(Ib/Q)=500lbf/ft; the applicable perpendicular-axis value is385.
